title: Alert not working
subtitle:
• Make sure that alerts are enabled in the system settings as follows: Settings > Apps > Moatheni > Notifications > Enable all options.
• Make sure that alerts are enabled in the application settings.
• If they do not work, restart the device.

title: Alert works without sound
subtitle:
• You will not hear the Adhan sound if your phone is on silent mode or Do Not Disturb mode. Please enable the alert during silent mode as follows: App Settings > More > Alert during silent mode.
• Make sure that the notification volume is increased in the system settings as follows: Settings > Sounds & Vibration > Increase the notification bar level.

title: Athan sound is weak
subtitle:
Make sure that the notification volume is increased in the system settings as follows:
Settings > Sounds & Vibration > Raise the notification bar.

title: Qibla direction is inaccurate
subtitle:
• Make sure there are no magnetic objects near your phone.
• Move your phone in a circular motion in the shape of a number 8.

title: Where can I find the monthly prayer times calendar?
subtitle: Tap on Prayer Times in the main app interface.

title: Where can I find the prayer times card?
subtitle: To view and share the prayer times card, tap on the share button at the top right of the app's main screen.

title: Add audio from device
subtitle: Currently not possible to add sounds from the device that are not in the application.

title: Add prayer widget to the lock screen
subtitle: Go to the application settings, then more, then enable the lock screen notification option.

title: Prayer times are inaccurate
subtitle: Make sure to choose the correct method for calculating prayer times in the application settings and make sure to adjust the prayer times minutes if needed.

title: Is the application free?
subtitle: The application is completely free and without ads and is constantly being developed. We ask Allah to benefit from it and make it a righteous deed accepted purely for His sake.
